title.en: An Act Appropriating the Sura of Fifteen thousand Pesos for Temporary Repairs to the Benguet Road Lying Within the Mountain Province.

text.en:
There is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated
the sum of fifteen thousand pesos for temporary repairs to the Benguet Road and other incidental expenses
necessitated thereby, to be expended under the direction of the Secretary of Commerce and Police: Provided,
That, after the expenditure of the sum hereby appropriated, if the Bureau of Public Works shall, at any time in
the future, notify the Secretary of Commerce and Police that the Benguet Road is unsafe for further traffic, the
said Benguet Road shall be declared permanently closed by the Secretary of Commerce and Police.

This Act shall take effect upon its passage.
Enacted, November 2, 1915.
